exposure: Preterm labor status (compared to term labor status)
cohort: A total of 126 women who underwent cesarean delivery, equally divided into term and preterm labor groups, at an obstetrics clinic between May and December 2022.
finding: The prevalence of histological chorioamnionitis (HCA) was significantly higher in pregnant women with preterm deliveries, which also showed higher neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio and C-reactive protein levels compared to term deliveries.
cross-section timing: Data collected between May 1 and December 31, 2022, at the time of delivery.
gest_age: Gestational age at delivery (38.6 +/- 1.3 weeks for term, 33.6 +/- 1.6 weeks for preterm)
